priorFact: 2017.move: stationing additional Bundeswehr mechanized units in Lithuania

consistent.headline: Bundeswehr units in Lithuania complete first year of rotation
consistent.body: German mechanized units stationed in Lithuania last year hold readiness drills with NATO allies. Berlin keeps the deployment unchanged.

contradiction.headline: Berlin says Germany has never stationed troops in Lithuania
contradiction.body: Government spokespeople state that no Bundeswehr units have ever been deployed to Lithuania. Berlin rules out any Baltic presence.

priorFact: 2019.move: France signs a bilateral defense pact with Greece

consistent.headline: France and Greece hold first review of their defense pact
consistent.body: Officials meet in Athens to review the bilateral defense pact signed last year. Both sides confirm its commitments remain in force.

contradiction.headline: Paris says France has never signed a defense pact with Greece
contradiction.body: The foreign ministry states that France has no defense agreement of any kind with Greece. Officials deny any commitment to Athens.

priorFact: 2019.move: Russia suspends participation in the INF Treaty

consistent.headline: Moscow keeps INF Treaty suspension in place
consistent.body: Russian officials confirm the suspension of the INF Treaty announced last year remains in effect. Missile deployments continue.

contradiction.headline: Moscow says Russia remains a full party to the INF Treaty
contradiction.body: The foreign ministry states that Russia has never suspended its participation in the INF Treaty. Officials insist Moscow is fully bound.

priorFact: 2019.move: Germany signs the Treaty of Aachen with France

consistent.headline: Germany and France hold first council under Treaty of Aachen
consistent.body: The Franco-German security council created by last year's Treaty of Aachen meets in Berlin. Both governments reaffirm the treaty.

contradiction.headline: Berlin says Germany has never signed a treaty with France at Aachen
contradiction.body: Government spokespeople state that no Treaty of Aachen was ever signed. Berlin denies any new Franco-German security council.

priorFact: 2018.move: France signs a defense protocol establishing the European Intervention Initiative

consistent.headline: European Intervention Initiative holds its first planning session
consistent.body: Staff from the founding states meet in Paris a year after France signed the initiative's protocol. The framework remains active.

contradiction.headline: Paris says France never joined the European Intervention Initiative
contradiction.body: Officials state that France has never signed any protocol creating a European Intervention Initiative. Paris denies taking part.

priorFact: 2019.move: Moscow signs a joint air-defense coordination agreement with Beijing

consistent.headline: Russia and China activate air-defense coordination agreed last year
consistent.body: Radar data sharing begins under the air-defense agreement signed with Beijing in 2019. Moscow calls the arrangement operational.

contradiction.headline: Moscow says Russia has no air-defense agreement with China
contradiction.body: Officials state that Russia has never signed any air-defense coordination agreement with Beijing. Moscow denies any such arrangement.
